preprocessing.detector_input: Same as training: longest edge <=1600; JPEG quality 75
preprocessing.crop: One lanternfly bounding box; pad each side by 15% of box dimensions; clamp to image
preprocessing.resize: Preserve aspect ratio; bilinear resize to fit 224x224; centered padding RGB (124,116,104), as PIL.ImageOps.pad
preprocessing.normalization: Embedded in model; do not normalize input yourself

output.name: dead_score
output.meaning: Uncalibrated dead score, not a validated probability

scope: Insect crop classifier only. Does not locate or identify lanternflies. Phone performance not tested.
